text: かんけー　ねー　やつは　ひっこんでな！

structure.jp: かんけー　ねー　やつは
structure.en: anyone who has nothing to do with this

patterns.name: 〜なさい
patterns.explanation: な after a て-form or verb stem is a clipped なさい, an order given from above. This is different from the 'don't' な that follows a plain verb. ひっこんでな = 'stay back, keep out of it'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: かんけー　ねー　やつ
patterns.explanation: The phrase before やつ describes it, like 'a guy who ...'. ねー is rough ない and かんけー is slurred かんけい, so かんけー ねー やつ = 'a guy who has nothing to do with it'.
